slots.name: Conversations: line under the heading
slots.text: See how Zeph thinks, responds, and helps you go deeper.

slots.name: Conversations: message 1, from Zeph
slots.text: You've been pushing hard lately. How are you actually feeling beneath the momentum?

slots.name: Conversations: message 2, from the person
slots.text: Honestly? Tired. But I'm also afraid to slow down. It feels like I'll fall behind if I do.

slots.name: Conversations: message 3, from Zeph
slots.text: That's a familiar pattern: equating rest with losing ground. What do you think you're really afraid of if you take a proper break?

slots.name: Conversations: message 4, from the person
slots.text: Maybe that I'm not as capable as I think. That the progress will stop, and I'll be left with the same old doubts again.

slots.name: Conversations: message 5, from Zeph
slots.text: That's a useful insight. It sounds less about productivity and more about self-trust. What would it look like to rest as part of your progress, and not as a pause from it?

slots.name: Conversations: message 6, from the person
slots.text: I'm thinking of a bigger change, maybe moving to a van and travelling for a while. It feels exciting, but also a bit reckless. Am I just escaping from something?

slots.name: Conversations: message 7, from Zeph
slots.text: It could be both: an escape and a deliberate step toward a life that feels more like you. Let's unpack it. What are you hoping to find on the road, and what are you hoping to leave behind?

FAQ: line under the heading
slots.text: Everything you need to know about Zeph.

slots.name: FAQ: first answer
slots.text: Zeph is an AI companion you talk to on Telegram. It draws on philosophy, psychology and mindfulness to help you reflect, question your assumptions and decide what matters to you.

slots.name: FAQ: second question
slots.text: How is this different from a regular AI chat?

slots.name: FAQ: second answer
slots.text: Zeph remembers what you have told it, with your permission, and it can reach out first at times you choose. It is built to ask good questions, and it will disagree with you when that is more useful than agreeing.

slots.name: FAQ: third question
slots.text: Will Zeph proactively check in with me?

slots.name: FAQ: third answer
slots.text: Only if you turn check-ins on. You pick the times and how often in your dashboard, and you can switch them off at any time.

slots.name: FAQ: fourth question
slots.text: Is my data private and secure?

slots.name: FAQ: fourth answer
slots.text: You decide what Zeph remembers, and you can read, remove or export it from your dashboard. [YOUR DATA HANDLING DETAILS]

slots.name: FAQ: fifth question
slots.text: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
